text: Vi mode lets you navigate the terminal viewport and scrollback with the keyboard
quote: The vi mode allows moving around Alacritty's viewport and scrollback using the keyboard.

text: Search the scrollback buffer forward/backward with keyboard shortcuts
quote: Search allows you to find anything in Alacritty's scrollback buffer. You can search forward using Ctrl Shift f (Command f on macOS) and backward using Ctrl Shift b (Command b on macOS).

text: Terminal hints let you mark and interact with visible text (e.g. URLs) without entering vi mode
quote: Terminal hints allow easily interacting with visible text without having to start vi mode.

text: A single Alacritty instance can run multiple terminal emulator windows
quote: Alacritty supports running multiple terminal emulators from the same Alacritty instance.

text: New windows can be created via a keybinding action or the alacritty msg create-window CLI subcommand
quote: New windows can be created either by using the `CreateNewWindow` keybinding action, or by executing the `alacritty msg create-window` subcommand.

text: Mouse selections can be expanded, semantically double-clicked, or line-selected via triple-click
quote: After making a selection, you can use the right mouse button to expand it. Double-clicking will expand the selection semantically, while triple-clicking will perform line selection. If you hold Ctrl while expanding the selection, it will sw

text: URLs in terminal output can be opened by clicking them with the mouse
quote: You can open URLs with your mouse by clicking on them. The modifiers required to be held and program which should open the URL can be setup in the configuration file.

text: Configuration supports importing additional config files, loaded in order
quote:
Import additional configuration files.

Imports are loaded in order, skipping all missing files, with the importing file being loaded last.

text: Config file changes can be live-reloaded without restarting (default on)
quote:
Live config reload (changes require restart)

Default: true

text: Supports BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows platforms
quote: The supported platforms currently consist of BSD, Linux, macOS and Windows.

text: Provides IPC control via the alacritty msg command
quote: Offer IPC using alacritty msg

text: Configuration file format is TOML
quote: Alacritty's configuration file uses the TOML format.

text: In vi mode, forward/backward search is bound to / and ?
quote: In vi mode the search is bound to / for forward and ? for backward search.

text: Vi mode supports starting a text selection with v and copying with y, including semantic/line/block modes
quote: By default you can start a selection using v and copy it using y. All selection modes that are available with the mouse can be accessed from vi mode, including the semantic (Alt v), line (Shift v) and block selection (Ctrl v).

text: Colors are configured via hexadecimal #RRGGBB values
quote: Colors are specified using their hexadecimal values with a _#_ prefix: _#RRGGBB_.

text: Keybinding actions SearchStart/SearchEnd let you jump to the start or end of a search match
quote: The `SearchStart` and `SearchEnd` keybinding actions can be bound if you're looking for a way to jump to the start or the end of a match.

text: Can request the compositor to blur content behind transparent windows
quote: Request compositor to blur content behind transparent windows.

text: Window padding around content can be configured and is DPI-scaled
quote: Blank space added around the window in pixels. This padding is scaled by DPI and the specified value is always added at both opposing sides.

text: Font x/y offsets allow fine-tuning letter spacing and line spacing
quote: Offset is the extra space around each character. _y_ can be thought of as modifying the line spacing, and _x_ as modifying the letter spacing.

text: Prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows are available via GitHub releases
quote:
Prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows can also be downloaded from the
[GitHub releases page]

text: Alacritty uses vtebench to measure and publish terminal throughput benchmarks, scoring better than competitors
quote: Alacritty uses vtebench to quantify terminal emulator throughput and manages to consistently score better than the competition using it.

text: Can be installed via various package managers across Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows
quote: Alacritty can be installed by using various package managers on Linux, BSD, macOS and Windows.
